findings.title: Oversized file (2578 lines)
findings.evidence: 2578 code lines — hard to hold in one head; a change here ripples widely.
findings.recommendation: Split into cohesive units by responsibility.

findings.title: File opened without context manager
findings.evidence: `open(...)` not wrapped in `with` — handle may leak on error.
findings.recommendation: Use `with open(...) as f:` for deterministic close.

findings.title: Broad exception handling
findings.evidence: Bare or Exception-wide `except` swallows errors indiscriminately.
findings.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions; re-raise or log the rest.
